assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: Equal-length freshly cut pale potato cylinders on a plain white laboratory tile beside one stainless cork borer. No numbers, labels, hands or people; ink and watercolour, transparent outside the objects.
